Hi Lena —

Thanks for locking in time with us for the product walkthrough on Tue, May 25 at 10:00am PT. Attached is a short demo prep doc and a link to our vendor onboarding questionnaire that procurement typically asks teams to complete before a technical demo. Completing the questionnaire ahead of the session helps us align the right engineering materials and avoids surprises on data handling or network requirements.

Files attached: redwood-demo-prep.pdf (pdf)
Vendor intake link: (weblink)

Quick asks:
- Could procurement complete the vendor questionnaire before the demo?
- If there's an NDA required from your side, please send the DocuSign link or the contact so we can loop legal.

Looping Monica from Solutions so she can prepare the environment-specific notes. If the questionnaire or NDA process will take longer than a few days, we can reschedule proactively — happy to propose alternate slots.

Subject: Re: Starlake Analytics — Demo scheduled 25 May / pre-demo intake

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the prep materials. Two quick items from our side that will block the May 25 session:

1) Procurement is requiring the completed vendor questionnaire and an executed NDA before they will approve a live technical demo with our engineering team. I've attached our intake form so you can see the required fields.
2) Our VP of Data, Tom Grant, who should attend the demo, is traveling internationally during the week of the 25th and won't be available. He specifically asked to be present for any deep architecture conversation.

Given both of those, can we push the session until procurement confirms the intake and we have an NDA signed? We can target early June. I'm looping procurement and Tom on this thread.

Attachment: starlake_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)

Proposed dates (all PT): June 7–9 any time after 9:30am, or June 14 afternoon. If Redwood can provide a SOC2 summary and a short vendor security checklist to speed procurement review, that would help.

Appreciate it —
Lena Brooks
Head of Data Platform, Starlake Analytics

- If procurement completes intake quickly, we're happy to do a condensed 30–45 minute preview for the execs and then a deeper technical session once the questionnaire passes.

Proposed backup slots (PT): 2027-06-07 10:00–11:00, 2027-06-08 14:00–15:00, 2027-06-14 15:30–16:30. Please confirm which works and procurement can mark the intake as in-progress.
